clientPanel.title: Your panel
clientPanel.body: For searching, hiring and following up.
points: Search professionals by service, area or name.
Save professionals, offers and jobs to review later.
Post a project when you need to hire and get replies.
Check your projects, favorites and connections from the panel.

proPanel.title: Professional panel
proPanel.body: For offering services and building trust.
points: Complete your profile, services, coverage and prices.
Upload success stories to show real work.
Handle projects, messages and quotes in one place.
You also keep the client panel to hire other services.

guides.providerNoteBody: With the same account you can offer your services and hire others: one dashboard for both.
guides.clientNoteBody: The professional guides stay available if you later want to offer services or post jobs or promotions.

clientPanel.title: Your panel
clientPanel.body: Your panel gathers what you need to hire: your projects, your favorites and your profile.
steps: Review your requests and projects from their sections.
Check the status of jobs you applied to.
Add professionals, offers and jobs to favorites for later.
Use Connections to see professionals with confirmed service history.
Open support if you need help with a request, account or access.

clientProjects.title: My projects
clientProjects.short: What you asked for and the replies
clientProjects.body: My projects lets you say what you need and have professionals reply.
steps: Create a clear post with service, location and description.
Professionals who can do it write to you on WhatsApp.
Choose the professional that fits the job best.

clientSaved.title: Favorites
clientSaved.body: Favorites gathers professionals, promotions and jobs you want to review later.
steps: Add professionals to favorites from Search or from their profile.
Save jobs and offers from their details.
Use filters to view professionals, offers or jobs separately.
Open each favorite to compare, contact or apply.

clientProfile.title: Client profile
clientProfile.body: Your profile helps identify you when you post a project or contact a professional.
steps: Keep name and contact updated.
Review account and security when changing sensitive data.
If you also offer services, turn it on from «Offer my services».

searchServices.title: Find professionals
searchServices.body: Find professionals lets you search options by service and location, with a map, filters and reviews.
steps: Type the service and location or use your current location.
Use Search this area when you move the map.
Filter by top rated, price and service language.
Review verification, reviews, coverage, availability and price.
Open the profile or contact by WhatsApp when you find a good option.

notificationsGuide.title: Notifications
notificationsGuide.body: Notifications gathers news about your projects, posts, followers, reviews, support and account alerts.
steps: Check the badge in the navbar when you have pending alerts.
Receive status changes for your projects and posts.
When you follow a professional, receive their new success stories, offers and jobs.
Use View all to open the notifications page.
Press each notification to open the related profile, ticket, job, offer or content directly.

reviewsGuide.title: Reviews
reviewsGuide.body: Reviews help people choose better and require an account to protect community trust.
steps: Open the professional profile.
Go to Reviews.
Log in or sign up if you do not have an account yet.
Write a clear, respectful and useful review.

jobsGuide.title: Jobs
jobsGuide.body: Jobs shows opportunities posted by professionals or businesses on ContrataCR.
steps: Search by role or profession.
Use filters like date posted, workplace, experience and employment type.
Open the job to review responsibilities, requirements, benefits and salary if published.
To apply, log in, confirm your contact details and attach your CV.

offersGuide.title: Promotions
offersGuide.body: Promotions shows promotions, packages, products or special services posted by professionals.
steps: Search for an offer by service, product or need.
Filter by date, type, service and price when available.
Review images, conditions, expiry date and the professional who posted it.
Contact the professional from the offer or open the profile for more context.

supportGuide.title: Support
supportGuide.body: Support lets you open tickets and continue conversations with the team.
steps: Open Support from your panel or from the help pages.
Create a ticket with a clear topic and details.
Open the ticket to continue the conversation and review replies.

accountSecurityGuide.title: Account and security
accountSecurityGuide.body: Account and security brings together email, password, ID, account disabling and permanent deletion.
steps: Review email and password when you need to update access.
Change your ID from Verification if your document changed or there was an error.
Disable the account if you want to hide it temporarily.
Use permanent deletion only if you want to remove the account for good.

professionalPanel.title: Professional panel
professionalPanel.body: The panel gathers your posts, quotes, success stories, services, support, profile and guides.
steps: Start with Complete your profile if you have pending steps.
Keep services, coverage, contact and availability updated.
Post jobs or offers if they apply to your business.
Use View my profile to review how clients see you.

completionGuide.title: Complete your profile
completionGuide.body: Complete your profile shows useful steps so your profile feels clearer and more trustworthy.
steps: Complete required steps first so you appear better in search.
Add optional steps like education, languages, public links and success stories if they strengthen your profile.
Ignore optional steps when they do not apply to your work.
When you save a checklist step, you return to the next pending step or to the panel if you are done.

opportunities.title: Projects
opportunities.body: Projects is the public board of what clients post. If something fits what you do, you message them straight on WhatsApp.
steps: Find a project that fits what you offer.
Read what they need and where.
Tap “WhatsApp” and answer them yourself.

successCases.title: Success stories
successCases.body: Success stories show completed work and help clients trust you before contacting you.
steps: Select the related service.
Upload clear photos of the result or process.
Write a short title and concrete description.
Keep your strongest and most recent stories visible.

services.title: Services
services.short: What you offer and how clients find you
services.body: Each service should include a clear name, description, fixed or negotiable price, experience and coverage.
steps: Add each service separately.
Use simple names clients would search for.
Complete description, price, experience and coverage.
Add a professional credential only when it applies to that service.

jobsPanel.title: Post jobs
jobsPanel.body: From Jobs you can publish opportunities linked to your business.
steps: Write a clear role or profession.
Define workplace, employment type, required experience and location.
Add salary if you want to show it.
Publish and manage your jobs from the panel; people apply on WhatsApp.

offersPanel.title: Publish promotions
offersPanel.body: From Promotions you publish your discounts and packages, with photos and clear conditions.
steps: Write a direct title and select a service from the ContrataCR catalog.
Add price, offer type and real images.
Define coverage, quantity and an available-until date when relevant.
Publish and edit the offer from your panel.

professionalProfile.title: Professional profile
professionalProfile.body: Your professional profile brings together public information and content that helps clients know and hire you.
steps: Complete basics and photo or logo.
Add education, coverage, contact, public links and languages if applicable.
Keep the services, offers, jobs and success stories shown on your profile up to date.
Review ID and verification status.
Use View my profile to see the public version.

proveedoresPage.metaDesc: How ContrataCR's identity verification works: we confirm the ID is real and the name matches official records. We verify identity, not the quality or outcome of the work.
proveedoresPage.intro: It's a confirmation that the provider's ID is real and that their name matches official records. It's automatic and earned: it gives more visibility to clients seeking extra trust, without blocking anyone.
proveedoresPage.step1Body: We automatically confirm that the ID number (Costa Rican national ID, DIMEX or NITE) exists in the official TSE records.
proveedoresPage.step2Body: We pull your official name straight from the TSE padrón. Your verification is granted instantly, no waiting.
proveedoresPage.step3Body: The padrón is updated periodically. If your case doesn't pass automatically, you can appeal and it's re-verified.
proveedoresPage.disclaimer: ContrataCR is an intermediary platform that connects clients with service providers; it is not the service provider. The “Verified” badge only confirms the ID is real and the name matches official records. It does not guarantee or ensure the quality, outcome or completion of any work, and does not by itself prove that the person who registered is physically that person. Hiring happens directly between the client and the provider. To choose well, every profile lets you compare reviews, success stories, training, languages and years of experience.

comoFunciona.metaTitle: How to use ContrataCR | Guide for clients and professionals
comoFunciona.metaDesc: Learn how to use ContrataCR to find professionals, post projects, find jobs, discover promotions and offer your services in Costa Rica.
comoFunciona.title: How to use ContrataCR
comoFunciona.subtitle: Find professionals, post what you need, find jobs, discover promotions or offer your services from a single account.
comoFunciona.metric0Label: Find professionals or post what you need.
comoFunciona.metric1Label: Client and professional coordinate payment directly.
comoFunciona.metric2Label: Built for cantons, local areas, and how services are coordinated here.
comoFunciona.pathsTitle: Choose the way that works best for you
comoFunciona.pathsSubtitle: If you already know who you want to contact, search for a professional. If you prefer to receive options, post what you need.
comoFunciona.clientPathDesc: Find professionals by service, location, reviews and reference price. Ideal when you want to compare and get in touch fast.
comoFunciona.clientStep0Body: Search by service, category, province, canton, or normal phrases like "I need to clean my house."
comoFunciona.clientStep1Body: Check the verified ID, past work, reviews, reference prices and service areas.
comoFunciona.clientStep2Body: Message them on WhatsApp, call them or write to them inside ContrataCR. Each profile shows the channels the professional left open.
comoFunciona.publishPathDesc: Tell us what needs doing once and professionals in your area reply.
comoFunciona.publishStep0Body: Pick the service and tell us what needs doing. The area is optional and remembered for next time.
comoFunciona.publishStep1Body: Your project goes on the public board and professionals in that service message you on WhatsApp straight from the post.
comoFunciona.publishStep2Body: Write to whoever suits you, agree on the details and close the project with "It's solved".
comoFunciona.clientsSubtitle: The app is designed so anyone can find help without understanding technology or chasing contacts.
comoFunciona.clientBenefit0Body: The search engine understands services, categories, cantons, and common phrases to help you reach the right professional.
comoFunciona.clientBenefit1Body: You see profiles, verified ID where available, reviews, success story photos, and relevant information before contacting them.
comoFunciona.clientBenefit2Body: Each profile says how they prefer to be contacted: WhatsApp, a call, or a message inside ContrataCR. No forms, no waiting.
comoFunciona.clientBenefit3Body: Save professionals, promotions and jobs; check your projects and quotes, and leave reviews from your dashboard.
comoFunciona.prosTitle: A profile that works for you
comoFunciona.prosSubtitle: ContrataCR helps people find you, compare you with confidence and contact you without taking control of your time or your prices.
comoFunciona.proFlowTitle: How do you start getting clients?
comoFunciona.proFlowDesc: Create your profile, explain your services, answer quickly and publish jobs or promotions whenever you need to.
comoFunciona.proStep0Body: Add a photo, description, services, years of experience, reference prices, languages, and areas where you work.
comoFunciona.proStep1Body: Publish success stories with photos, complete your workplaces, and verify your identity to build more trust.
comoFunciona.proStep2Body: See the projects clients post, message them on WhatsApp, send quotes and publish jobs or promotions from your dashboard.
comoFunciona.proBenefit0Body: The badge shows that the ID on your profile exists in the TSE electoral roll and that your name comes from it.
comoFunciona.proBenefit1Body: Showcase photos of your success stories so your profile isn't just text and the client understands your quality.
comoFunciona.proBenefit2Body: Define cantons, exact locations, or areas where you serve to appear in relevant searches.
comoFunciona.proBenefit3Body: Get alerts about new projects, quotes, messages and support, each linking straight to the detail.
comoFunciona.proBenefit4Body: The client pays you directly. The platform does not hold money or charge a percentage on each job.
comoFunciona.proBenefit5Body: Besides replying to projects, you can post jobs and promotions related to your services.
comoFunciona.marketplaceTitle: Jobs and promotions in the same ecosystem
comoFunciona.marketplaceSubtitle: Explore job opportunities and promotions without leaving ContrataCR.
comoFunciona.marketplaceJobsBody: Search by role, work mode, experience, and date. Open the job and message whoever posted it on WhatsApp.
comoFunciona.marketplaceOffersBody: Compare promotions by service, price, location, and availability period; save them to Favorites or contact the professional.
comoFunciona.marketplaceProjectsBody: Projects is the board of what clients post. Read what they need and where, then message them on WhatsApp.
comoFunciona.trustSubtitle: The idea is not to complicate the process: it is to show just enough for the client and professional to decide quickly.
comoFunciona.trust0Body: We validate identification against official records when applicable. Each document type follows its own validation, and some cases may require review.
comoFunciona.trust1Body: Reviews require an account and are moderated to keep the community trustworthy.
comoFunciona.trust2Body: ContrataCR organises the search, the projects and the quotes; the final arrangements happen by message, WhatsApp or phone.
comoFunciona.trust3Body: The professional decides whether to offer contact by phone or email within their service options.
comoFunciona.trust4Body: Some services can indicate that they offer video appointments. It appears where it adds value without overcrowding cards.
comoFunciona.trust5Body: Profiles can show languages, work locations, coverage, and details that help you choose better.
comoFunciona.compareTitle: The app organizes what was previously scattered.
comoFunciona.compareSubtitle: Instead of relying solely on isolated recommendations, everything becomes a clear flow.
comoFunciona.compare0Body: Chats, groups, recommendations, and posts all get mixed up. It is hard to compare and keep track.
comoFunciona.compare1Title: Now: profiles and projects in one place
comoFunciona.compare1Body: You search, post, get replies, save items and review your history from your panel.
comoFunciona.compare2Body: ContrataCR does not get involved in payment or the final agreement. Client and professional decide together.
comoFunciona.faqSubtitle: Short answers to explain the app before someone tries it.
comoFunciona.faq0Q: Does ContrataCR charge commission on services?
comoFunciona.faq0A: We do not charge a commission on each job. Price, payment, and service details are agreed directly between client and professional.
comoFunciona.faq1Q: What does it mean for a profile to be verified?
comoFunciona.faq1A: It means we confirmed the person's identity when the ID can be validated. It is not a guarantee of quality or outcome, so reviews and success stories also matter.
comoFunciona.faq2Q: Can I use the app if I don't know exactly what service I need?
comoFunciona.faq2A: Yes. You can type a normal phrase in search or post a project explaining the problem. The app tries to connect you with related services.
comoFunciona.faq3Q: How do I request a quote?
comoFunciona.faq3A: From a professional's profile you can request a quote describing what you need. They answer with the price and conditions, and the quote is kept in your dashboard so you can compare it with others.
comoFunciona.faq4Q: What happens if I post a project?
comoFunciona.faq4A: Your project stays on the public board and professionals in that service message you on WhatsApp straight from the post. You compare profiles, talk to whoever you prefer and close the project once it is solved.
comoFunciona.faq5Q: How does it work for professionals?
comoFunciona.faq5A: You create your profile and add services, areas, reference prices and photos of your past work. Then you can answer projects posted by clients, send quotes and publish jobs or promotions.
comoFunciona.faq6Q: Will my data be made public?
comoFunciona.faq6A: We do not publish your ID. Contact is handled in a controlled way, and each professional chooses which channels to enable.
comoFunciona.faq7Q: Is it suitable for both large and small services?
comoFunciona.faq7A: Yes. You can search for everything from quick repairs to professional services, health, education, technology, home, events, and more.
comoFunciona.ctaSubtitle: If you need help, find professionals. You can also explore jobs and promotions or create your profile to offer services.

ayuda.faqSubtitle: The most common questions from our community.
ayuda.faq0Q: Does ContrataCR charge any commission or fee?
ayuda.faq0A: We don't charge commissions on the services you hire: you arrange payment directly with the professional, off the platform.
ayuda.faq1Q: How do I start offering services?
ayuda.faq1A: Click 'Offer my services' in the navigation bar. You can sign up with your email or with Google. First you choose your services and work areas; then you complete your photo, description, and profile details.
ayuda.faq2A: We validate identification against official records when applicable. National and legal-entity IDs follow the flow for their type; DIMEX, NITE, and special cases may require review. The badge confirms identity, not the quality of the work. Every profile lets you compare reviews from other clients, success stories, training and certifications, languages, years of experience, areas and a reference price. That way you choose with information.
ayuda.faq3A: Use the search bar on the home page or Find professionals. You can search by service, province, and canton, and sort by rating. Search understands synonyms: typing 'nanny' can also find childcare professionals.
ayuda.faq4Q: How do I coordinate the service?
ayuda.faq4A: If you search directly, open the profile and use whichever contact the professional enabled: WhatsApp, a call, or a message inside ContrataCR. If you post a project, professionals message you and you carry on with whoever you prefer.
ayuda.faq5Q: How do I leave a review?
ayuda.faq5A: Open the professional's profile and go to Reviews. If you are not signed in, ContrataCR asks you to log in or create an account, then brings you back to the profile.
ayuda.faq6A: Posting a project is an alternative to searching directly. You describe what you need (for example: 'paint a 4x4 m living room') and professionals in that service reply with a message; then you write to the one you prefer.
ayuda.faq7A: Your identity document is not published, and contact details are shown only through the options enabled on the platform. We process personal information under Costa Rica's Data Protection Law 8968.
ayuda.faq8Q: How do I add ContrataCR to my home screen?
ayuda.faq8A: You can add ContrataCR as a shortcut from your browser menu.
ayuda.faq9Q: How do I apply for a job?
ayuda.faq9A: Open the job and tap Contact on WhatsApp to message whoever posted it. If the job has no WhatsApp, you will see Apply: fill in your details, attach your CV and track the status from your dashboard.
ayuda.faq10A: Search by name or service and review images, price, availability period, location, and terms. You can save the promotion to Favorites or contact the professional from the listing.
ayuda.faq11Q: What can I add to Favorites?
ayuda.faq11A: You can save professionals, promotions and jobs. In your dashboard, the Saved section has filters to see each type separately.
ayuda.contactTitle: Didn't find what you were looking for?
ayuda.cat8Desc: How to ask for a price in writing and compare answers.
ayuda.cat9Desc: How to write to a professional inside ContrataCR.
ayuda.faq12Q: How do I request a quote?
ayuda.faq12A: From the professional's profile, request a quote describing what you need. They answer with the price and conditions, and the quote is kept in your dashboard so you can compare it with others and have it in writing.
ayuda.faq13Q: Can I message a professional without giving out my number?
ayuda.faq13A: Yes. Besides WhatsApp and phone, ContrataCR has its own messages: you write from their profile and the conversation stays in the Messages section of your dashboard. They only see your number if you choose to share it.
ayuda.faq14Q: How do I delete my account?
ayuda.faq14A: Open your dashboard, go to My profile and look for Delete account. We explain what gets deleted and what is kept before you confirm. If you would rather we do it, open a case in the Support centre.
ayuda.faq15Q: How do I choose a good professional? Does ContrataCR guarantee the work?
ayuda.faq15A: ContrataCR gives you what you need to compare: reviews from other clients, success stories, training and certifications, languages, years of experience, areas and a reference price. Read the reviews, look at success stories on jobs like yours and message two or three professionals. You agree on price, timing and any warranty on the work directly with the professional: put it in writing before starting. If something goes wrong, leave an honest review and, if there was deceit or abuse, report the profile.

atraerClientes.subtitle: A practical guide to completing the information clients review before choosing a professional.
atraerClientes.profileChecklistTitle: The essentials of a complete profile
atraerClientes.profileChecklistSubtitle: Prioritize these actions. Each one helps clients understand who you are, what you do, and where you work.
atraerClientes.tip0Body: A clear, well-lit photo where your face is visible helps the client understand who they are talking to. It is a simple trust signal compared with a profile with no photo or an unclear one.
atraerClientes.tip0Highlight: No blurry photos, dark glasses, or party pics.
atraerClientes.tip1Body: Verification confirms your identity with official records when applicable. It does not certify the quality of your work, but it helps the client know you are a real, verifiable person. Verified professionals appear first in results and show the 'Verified' badge.
atraerClientes.tip1Highlight: Verified professionals show higher in search.
atraerClientes.tip2Body: Photos of real success stories are what convinces most. Before hiring, many clients want to see examples of what you do: a renovated kitchen, a well-kept garden, a design you made, or any real evidence of your work.
atraerClientes.tip2Highlight: Photos of your success stories build more trust.
atraerClientes.tip3Body: Fast replies build trust. If a client contacts you on WhatsApp and you take too long, they will probably look for another option. Keep your contact information updated and reply as soon as you can.
atraerClientes.tip3Highlight: Response speed is your biggest differentiator.
atraerClientes.tip4Title: Ask for reviews after every service
atraerClientes.tip4Body: After finishing a service, ask the client to leave you a review on ContrataCR. A short line like 'Could you leave me a review on the platform? It really helps me get more clients' is usually enough.
atraerClientes.tip4Highlight: Ask right after the job, while the experience is still fresh for the client.
atraerClientes.tip5Body: Set your work zones or locations in your profile. Clients can search by canton, so the more precise your places are, the easier it is to appear in relevant searches. If you serve several cantons, add them clearly.
atraerClientes.tip5Highlight: Clearer zones create better matches in local searches.
atraerClientes.tip6Body: Avoid generic phrases like 'I'm the best in Costa Rica' or 'I work with quality'. Instead, describe exactly what you do, how many years of experience you have, and what types of jobs are your specialty. Specificity builds trust.
atraerClientes.tip6Highlight: Example: '12 years as an electrician. Specialized in residential installations and preventive maintenance.'
atraerClientes.tip7Body: When a client asks for a price, answer with a quote from ContrataCR: it is in writing, with the breakdown and the amount. It is what most helps clients pick you over someone who just said a number on the phone.
atraerClientes.tip7Highlight: A written quote avoids misunderstandings and leaves you better placed than a price said from memory.
atraerClientes.growthToolsTitle: More ways to grow on ContrataCR
atraerClientes.growthToolsSubtitle: Besides answering projects and sending quotes, you can publish promotions from your professional dashboard.
atraerClientes.jobsBody: Create openings with location, workplace type, experience and salary. Review applications, download the submitted CV and update each candidate's status from Jobs.
atraerClientes.offersBody: Publish promotions with images, price, available quantity and coverage. People can discover them, add them to Favorites and contact you through the methods you enabled.
atraerClientes.dosDontsSubtitle: Small habits that help clients feel safer when contacting you:
dos: Give an approximate price in the first message
Confirming the visit the day before
Arrive on time or warn if you're running late
donts: Ignore inquiries and reply days later
Give prices very different from the initial quote
Cancel at the last minute without a serious reason
Ask for full payment before starting
atraerClientes.ctaSubtitle: Complete your profile, verify your identity, and keep your services up to date.
